Event overview

Tuesday 24 and Wednesday 25 November

09:30 - 16:30

Radisson Blue Hotel, Perth

£495 - Members / £595 - Non-members 

Contact our team at scotlandevents@rcgp.org.uk




This two-day course is open to trainees, general practitioners and practice nurses and will enable attendees to develop the skills required to run a successful minor surgery service in primary care.




Topics covered include minor skin procedures and non-surgical techniques, as well as advice about how to set up a service and the medico-legal, and contractual obligations required of those practising minor surgery.




The training will be delivered by the College-approved Medical Skills courses who are professional and highly skilled GPs, plastic surgeons, orthopaedic surgeons and physiotherapists who will teach the advanced skills required to manage a successful minor surgery practice. 




As a team, they are committed to excellence and dedicated to equipping healthcare professionals with the knowledge and skills needed to deliver high-quality patient care.




The tutors are friendly, approachable, and committed to providing excellent post-course support. Course content is regularly reviewed and updated to reflect changes in commissioning priorities, regulatory requirements, and best practice.




For more information, please click on programme button above to see these details. A full programme will be sent out to registered delegates prior to the workshop. 




Interested in other medical skills courses?

We are also running a one-day Joint Injections workshop on Monday 23 November 2026. For more details and to register, check out our webpage. 




*Please note that all dietary and access requirements are pulled from your MyRCGP account at the time of booking. Please ensure this information is up to date: Login > My details > My event preferences.




The RCGP is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion, celebrating diversity and ensuring our members feel valued. Equality and inclusion are essential principles in our work and this meeting will be conducted in a way which reflects the diverse communities and respects individual differences. By attending this event, you are agreeing to welcome and respect the unique contributions and life experiences of each attendee and the speakers and abide by these terms.
